adjudication.rationale: In `addGuestsHandler`, the `CalendarEvent` (`evt`) passed to `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` is constructed without any `team` field (only `title/type/description/times/organizer/attendees/...`). In `sendAddGuestsEmails`, the only way to notify additional team members is the branch `if (calendarEvent.team?.members) { for (const teamMember of calendarEvent.team.members) ... }`, which will be skipped when `team` is undefined. The diff also shows the booking query includes `eventType: true` but does not include `eventType.team`/`team.members`, so there is no source in this handler to populate `evt.team`. Therefore, as implemented in this diff, the team-member notification loop is effectively unreachable from this caller and team members other than the organizer won’t receive `OrganizerAddGuestsEmail`.
